name: statusline
description: Cam's Claude Code statusline, in two lines: path, git branch and the tracking plugin's session State; then model, reasoning effort, context-window occupancy, and weekly and 5-hour plan limits paced against your working week. Also renders the agent panel's subagent rows, each from that task's own model, effort, directory and context. Wired explicitly via /statusline:setup — installing changes nothing.
